coder_result.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
gas_df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/outlierr/2023_gas.csv")
adj_df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv")

# Compute each borough's neighborhood mean Gas_value
# First, join adjacency to get neighbor Gas_values
adj_with_values = adj_df.merge(
    gas_df.rename(columns={"borough": "neighbor", "Gas_value": "neighbor_value"}),
    on="neighbor",
    how="left"
)
neigh_means = (
    adj_with_values
    .groupby("borough")["neighbor_value"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"neighbor_value": "neighbor_mean"})
)
# Merge back to gas_df
merged_df = gas_df.merge(neigh_means, on="borough", how="left")

# Iterative-R procedure
threshold = 1.96
all_boroughs = set(merged_df["borough"])
inliers = set(all_boroughs)
city_name = "City of London"

city_flagged_stat = None  # to record City of London's stat when flagged (or final stat)
iteration = 0

while True:
    iteration += 1
    # Subset data to current inliers, drop any missing neighbor_mean
    df_sub = (
        merged_df[merged_df["borough"].isin(inliers)]
        .dropna(subset=["neighbor_mean", "Gas_value"])
        .copy()
    )
    n = len(df_sub)
    if n == 0:
        break  # no data left
    # Design matrix X: intercept + neighbor_mean
    X = np.vstack([np.ones(n), df_sub["neighbor_mean"].values]).T
    y = df_sub["Gas_value"].values
    # OLS estimates
    XtX = X.T.dot(X)
    XtX_inv = np.linalg.inv(XtX)
    beta = XtX_inv.dot(X.T).dot(y)
    y_hat = X.dot(beta)
    res = y - y_hat
    mse = (res**2).sum() / (n - X.shape[1])
    sigma_hat = np.sqrt(mse)
    # Leverage h_ii
    H = X.dot(XtX_inv).dot(X.T)
    h_ii = np.diag(H)
    # Studentized residuals
    stud_res = res / (sigma_hat * np.sqrt(1 - h_ii))
    # Map borough to its studentized residual
    res_series = pd.Series(stud_res, index=df_sub["borough"].values)
    # Identify provisional outliers
    prov_outliers = set(res_series.index[np.abs(res_series) > threshold])
    # If City of London is flagged now, record its stat (first time)
    if city_flagged_stat is None and city_name in prov_outliers:
        city_flagged_stat = res_series[city_name]
    # If no provisional outliers, we're done
    if not prov_outliers:
        break
    # Remove them for next iteration
    new_inliers = inliers - prov_outliers
    if new_inliers == inliers:
        break
    inliers = new_inliers

# After convergence, if City was never flagged, compute its final residual
if city_flagged_stat is None:
    # City remained an inlier; get its residual from last fit
    if city_name in res_series.index:
        city_flagged_stat = res_series[city_name]
    else:
        # Should not happen, but fallback
        city_flagged_stat = np.nan
    flagged = False
else:
    flagged = True

# Number of data points used in final model
data_points_used = len(df_sub)

# Decide verdict
if flagged:
    if city_flagged_stat > 0:
        verdict = "OUTLIER - HIGH"
    else:
        verdict = "OUTLIER - LOW"
else:
    verdict = "NOT AN OUTLIER"

# Print results
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (z = {city_flagged_stat})")
